summary: New code isn't in codecov.io reports, so collect coverage locally with --coverage and generate HTML, console or XML reports; HTML lands in test/results/reports/coverage/index.html.
questions: Where does ansible-test write the HTML coverage report?
How do I check coverage for a unit test I just wrote?
Why is my new code missing from codecov?

answer_card.title: Coverage for new unit tests
answer_card.answer_md:
New code isn't in codecov.io yet, so generate coverage locally:
```shell
ansible-test units --coverage apt
ansible-test coverage html
```
The report is at `test/results/reports/coverage/index.html`. Also available: `coverage report` (console), `coverage xml`. Clear data with `ansible-test coverage erase`.
